description: Break a wiki page's inheritance of the restrictions above it ('inherit': false), or restore it ('inherit': true). Breaking makes the lists in force on the page its own — nobody gains or loses a right at that moment — and from then on only those lists decide who reads and edits the page and its subtree, within the project's access; a grant «with all child pages» on a page above stops there too. Restoring keeps the page's own lists and applies the ones above again, so it only narrows. The project's administrators only; never the space's home page. In the company's journal.

inherit.description: true to inherit the restrictions above, false to break inheritance.

name: set_wiki_page_inheritance
title: Set wiki page inheritance
